module_summary: UART receive timer: a 19-bit down-counter loaded with 8x or 4x the divisor on ld_long/ld_half, counting to zero and signalling idle_o.

anchors.name: tq
anchors.why: Down-counter decremented while nonzero, loaded from scaled divisor.

anchors.name: idle_o
anchors.why: High when counter reaches zero; also gates decrement versus load.

anchors.name: ld_long
anchors.why: Loads full-bit period (divisor x8) into counter.

anchors.name: ld_half
anchors.why: Loads half-bit period (divisor x4) into counter.

anchors.name: div_i
anchors.why: Baud divisor input scaled into counter load value.

anchors.name: wide_div
anchors.why: Zero-extended divisor shifted to form load values.

groups.name: bit_timer
groups.description: Loadable down-counter timing UART bit periods.
